correctness.rationale: For a symmetric loop-free cycle, conflict-free S defends its members; completeness requires no undecided isolated vertex in U=V\(S∪N(S)). A cyclic selected-vertex gap d produces undecided run length d−3 when d>=4: d=4 leaves exactly one isolated node, while d∈{2,3} or >=5 is valid. The gap condition therefore holds for any n>=3, including one-selected-vertex wrap n. Marked cyclic compositions count c_{n,k}=n/k[z^n]G(z)^k, G=z²+z³+z^5/(1−z), and rational generating series follows. The positive root of G(r)=1 is the unique circle-of-convergence pole using coprime 2 and 3, so leading asymptotic constant exactly one. Independently checked the Dung defender definition for all 65528 subsets for 3<=n<=15 against gaps and exact counts; no finite experiment is claimed to prove all n.
